query:
UPDATE user_sessions s
            SET refresh_token_hash = $2,
                expires_at = now() + make_interval(days => $3),
                updated_at = now()
           FROM users u
          WHERE s.refresh_token_hash = $1
            AND s.expires_at > now()
            AND u.id = s.user_id
            AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
         RETURNING u.id, u.role
